title: Great bar stools!
text: Great bar stools!. These stools (we purchased the cherry color) are definitely worth the effort of assembling them! My husband, who's the pro in our house at putting together our impulse-buy Ikea finds, assembled both of these stools in about 1.5 hours. He said some of the legs were not properly labeled according to the instruction manual, and screwing the cross-pieces onto the legs was somewhat awkward. I don't think I would have had the patience for it, haha. However, once assembled (see pics) the stools were perfect! The cushions are comfortable, and the cross-pieces on the stool legs are the perfect place to rest your feet. All four legs of each stool sit flush to the floor with no rocking or unsteadiness. One of the reasons I liked these stools over other options is because there are no buttons or other studs that could be broken, pulled, or chewed off. Ha! I almost took off a star for the assembly process, but in the end, they're such great, solid stools that I'm sticking with 5 stars.

description: Redefine your living space, with the Crosley Furniture Upholstered Square Stools as they elevate the style and sophistication, wherever you place them. Clean lines marry with an attractive black upholstered leather seat featuring a high density foam that cushions and comforts. Small enough to tuck away nicely, yet stately enough to hold its own presence in any setting. The Upholstered Square Seat Stool features solid hardwood construction and the cushioned seat is upholstered in simulated leather, that is stain and spill resistant. This exceptional craftsmanship is sure to become a staple in any room. The 24-inch height make this stool perfect for a 36-inch height dining table or counter seating.
